caseName: Samara v. Oklahoma Capitol Improvement Authority
caseNameFull: SAMARA v. OKLAHOMA CAPITOL IMPROVEMENT AUTHORITY
attorneys: Leroy Powers and Gus Rinehart for appellants., Charles Nesbitt, Attorney General of Oklahoma, and Harvey H. Cody and Joseph C. Muskrat, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari,, certiorari is denied.
